title: Counting basic-irreducible factors mod p^k in deterministic poly-time and p-adic applications
notes: docs/theory/padic_lifting_trees.md. Counts all roots of f mod p^k in deterministic poly(deg f, k log p) time, including the first deterministic count of the lifts of a repeated root. Any complexity claim in this project must be compared against this bound; state compression is reported as structure, not as a speedup.
